McpPlanTransportChoice.description: One eligible way to run the server, represented as a tagged package or remote variant so package identity and endpoint states cannot contradict the install method.

requiredValues.description: Typed values this choice requires, excluding secrets.

items.description: A secret a transport choice needs, referenced by placeholder. No secret value ever appears in a plan, and the placeholder resolves against the keychain only when a plan is applied.

secretPlaceholders.description: Secrets this choice requires, referenced by placeholder only.
